scope: School research summaries, not ready-to-use degree templates. Use exact reviewed degree plans for enrollment decisions.

methodology.summary: Short summaries of the linked official sources, with separately identified learner discussions.
methodology.rankings: Compare only the same degree level, delivery mode, units and credit-origin policy basis. Unknown metrics receive no rank.
methodology.cost: School prices use different billing units and are not a degree-cost ranking. Use your course plan for comparable remaining-cost estimates.
methodology.speed: Self-paced availability is a format fact, not a finish-time estimate or an ease rating.

methodology.reviews: No external discussion is counted as a DegreeSteps review or a verified transfer outcome.
